text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Police issue identikit in hunt for three men who held up Group Four security guard and escaped with Lm500,000 ($1.3 million) in cash.

- Foreign Minister George Vella says European security measures should have a parallel in the Mediterranean. He tells a ministerial meeting in Strasbourg that regional security should be guaranteed by peaceful rather than military means.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sants tells Joseph Psaila, an assistant police commissioner, and superintendent Charles Cassar to resign from the force "in the public interest" after being mentioned in court in an alleged frame-up .
- Group Four robbery, the biggest in Malta in 10 years.
